places.name: Little River Canyon: The Concave
places.access: NPS preserve: park only in the marked pull-offs, all tyres off the pavement; no camping; no bolts added or removed.

places.name: Rocktown (Pigeon Mountain)
places.access: Crockford-Pigeon Mountain WMA: a hunting or fishing licence or a Georgia Lands Pass, bought ahead; closed during posted hunts; no camping at the lot.

places.name: Sand Rock (Cherokee Rock Village)
places.access: Cherokee County park: a per-car day fee at the gate; quiet hours 8 pm to 8 am; soft sandstone, so don't climb when it's wet.
